source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: R2-B: the markers' own states -- hover emphasis, emphasis.focus / blurScope around the host series, data items' own emphasis and blur, a click selecting the host's item. Driven and recorded as advchart-states-misc.json; a label also has tx / ty, its computed transform's translation.

clock.note: each case on a clock of its own, later than every earlier one (the generation runs twice): only times relative to its t0, where the option is set and the settle starts, are written; T1 = t0 + T1Offset

cases.note: hover the markPoint pin at 0: the path's fill lifts (no emphasis declared), z2 + 10, the scale _sizeX * 1.1; its inside label (40 % down the pin) rides the scaled pin; out at 500

item-level emphasis over the markPoint's: item 0 a colour and border of its own and a label colour, item 1 (symbolSize 30, a right label) emphasis.scale 1.5; the markPoint's emphasis border width 4; hover mp0 at 0, mp1 at 400, out at 800
circle markPoints of size 16 with labels top / right / bottom: hovering each, its label moves out with the scaled circle (ratio max(1.1, 3 / 8)); scale false on the third keeps it

hover the markLine (average) at 0: the line's width 3 (the model's default emphasis), its stroke lifted, the end symbols' fill lifted, every z2 + 10, the label in emphasis; the max line at 500; out at 1000

markLine items with emphasis of their own over the markLine's width 5: item 0 a lineStyle colour and width (the end symbols take the colour as their fill), item 1 a label colour, item 2 emphasis disabled (no dispatcher: no hover at all); hover each
hover two markAreas: the first lifts (fill), the second has an item emphasis colour; out
the markPoint's emphasis.focus series: hovering it blurs the other series (one grid) and its markPoint, not the host; out at 500
an item's emphasis.focus self: hovering it blurs both series, the host's other markers and the other's; the hovered pin blurs and then enters emphasis; out at 500
the markLine's emphasis focus self, blurScope series: only the host series and its markers blur; out at 500
a markArea's emphasis.focus series is never read (toggleHoverEmphasis(polygon, null)): hovering it blurs nothing
the markPoint's emphasis disabled: no hover state, and under the other series' focus its blur is the declared one alone (none: no change)
hovering a markPoint, then a highlight by action of the other series (focus series) blurs the host and the hovered pin with it; the downplay takes the blur off and the pin is normal under the pointer

the other series' focus series blurs the host: the markers' data items' own blur styles over the component's -- a markPoint item opacity 0.5 (the other item takes the markPoint's 0.3), a markLine item's lineStyle colour and opacity (its end symbols take both), a markArea item's opacity, a label's opacity
an item emphasis.focus on a markLine data item (series), the markLine's own focus none: hovering item 1 blurs the other series; item 0 blurs nothing

the host selectedMode single: a click on mp0 (the max, data index 0 of the marker) selects the host's item 0 -- the marker is never selected, so the second click selects again; select.itemStyle on the markPoint changes nothing

emphasis textConfig: the markPoint's emphasis.label.position top over the pin's inside label; item 1 (a circle of 20, a right label at rest) its own emphasis label at the bottom, distance 8, offset [3, 2]; item 2 (a circle) an emphasis rotate of 30; hover mp0 at 0, mp1 at 400, mp2 at 800, out at 1200

a markPoint label hidden at rest (label.show false) and shown by a state: the markPoint's emphasis.label.show (at the top) on hover; item 1's blur.label.show under the other series' focus; hover mp0 at 0, out at 300, the other series at 500, out at 900
a markLine label hidden at rest and shown in emphasis (the markLine's emphasis.label.show): hover ml0 at 0, out at 500
markArea labels: the first hidden at rest and shown in emphasis; the second shown at rest (top) and moved to insideBottom by its emphasis.label.position; hover ma0 at 0, ma1 at 400, out at 800

[R2-I3] the emphasis label's text style merged over the normal one and laid out again (setLabelStyle's state style): mp0 (a circle of 20, its label at the top) emphasis fontSize 20, bold, #cc0000; mp1 its own emphasis fontSize 16 at the right (normal left); emphasis.scale false. Hover mp0 at 0, mp1 at 400, out at 800

[R2-I3] a rich markPoint label in emphasis: {a|A}{b|B} with a 14 and b 10 and blue at the right; the emphasis position left and a rich of its own, a 18 -- the state style's rich replaces the normal one (b loses its 10 and its blue: the 12 of the block); hover mp0 at 0, out at 500
